# Soul Virtues Extractor
> The free 66-question Undertale soul trait assessment and multi-dimensional virtue calculator. Discover your exact percentage distribution across Determination, Bravery, Justice, Kindness, Patience, Integrity, and Perseverance.

Soul Virtues Extractor provides an interactive, client-side psychometric personality quiz based on the seven human soul traits from Undertale. It features 66 carefully weighted statements, instant 7-trait breakdown, and shareable soul result cards.

## Core Features
- [Soul Virtues Test](https://soulvirtues.org/): Free 66-question online assessment and instant analysis
- [Seven Soul Virtues](https://soulvirtues.org/#virtues): In-depth guide to Determination, Bravery, Justice, Kindness, Patience, Integrity, and Perseverance
- [Scoring System](https://soulvirtues.org/#scoring): Multi-dimensional weighting and non-linear power curve algorithm

## Resources
- [FAQ](https://soulvirtues.org/#faq): Answers to common questions regarding scoring, soul colors, and card sharing
- [Contact](https://soulvirtues.org/contact): Get in touch with the creator via contact@soulvirtues.org
